title: feat(digital-factory-ui-bugfix/T6): fix Playwright networkidle timeout and repo rendering
body:
## Changes

### Fix: Playwright browser QA networkidle timeout
- Removed `page.waitForLoadState("networkidle")` from `navigateToQAPage` helper in `tests/browser-qa/t6-browser-qa.spec.ts`
- Replaced with `page.waitForSelector("h1")` only — networkidle can time out at 60s on dev servers with long-lived connections

### Fix: Repo rendered as plain text, not link
- Updated `FeatureTaskDrilldown.tsx` `DrilldownMetadataSection` to render repo as plain `<span>` text instead of `<a>` link
- Per spec: "Task repository metadata in the Task tab must be plain text, not a link"

### Test: DOM rendering check for repository regression
- Replaced `typeof repo === "string"` check with actual DOM rendering test using `DrilldownTaskContent`
- Verifies repo text appears in rendered output and is not wrapped in `<a>` tags

## Testing
- All 916 unit tests pass across 46 test files
- No lint errors (2 pre-existing warnings in unrelated file)
head: feature/digital-factory-ui-bugfix-T6
